name: johnny-project-team-codex
description: Codex-compatible Johnny Project Team workflow with project-scoped physical Git gates, complete path-routed ECC rules, per-ticket TDD/SDD DQA, and optional Claude DQA.

interface.shortDescription: Project phases, complete ECC rules, DQA, and local Git gates.
interface.longDescription: Runs the Johnny Project Team workflow in Codex. It routes every bundled ECC common, language, and framework rule to matching code paths. Every ticket maps one-to-one to a small milestone and passes TDD DQA followed by SDD DQA before user review. Claude DQA is available for manual cross-checking and is off by default.
defaultPrompt: Use Johnny Project Team for this project.
Keep Claude DQA off unless I explicitly request an external cross-check.
